Combat and equipment

Why can't I install a new attachment on the weapon?

  • Your weapon slots are likely full.

  • Check your weapon menu and remove an existing modification to make room for a new one!

    Note: When you craft a weapon, it is randomly assigned attachment slots - the number of slots depends on the weapon type and can range from one to three.

    • These slots allow you to equip attachments such as sights (Holosight, Optical Scope) and other modifications that improve weapon performance.
    • The number of slots you receive is determined at the moment of crafting and cannot be changed afterward, so crafting the same weapon multiple times may yield different slot configurations.
